# UIGridLayout

- Inherits [`Instance`](instance.md)
- Created with `Instance.new("UIGridLayout")`

Arranges its parent's `UIObject` children in a grid of equal cells (ADR 0128): an inventory, a shop, a level select. A modifier, like `UIListLayout`: parented beside what it arranges.

A child laid out by one loses its `Position` and its `Size` -- every cell is `CellSize`. The cells fill a line until the next would not fit, or until `FillDirectionMaxCells`, and then start another.

**Members below are the ones this class DECLARES.** Everything its base
offers is on the base's page, which is what keeps one added member on
`Instance` from being a change to every page here.

## Properties

| Name | Type | Default | Access | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `AbsoluteContentSize` | `Vector2` | — | read-only | How much room the cells take, in pixels, as the last layout found it. What a `ScrollFrame`'s `CanvasSize` is set from. |
| `CellPadding` | `UDim2` | `UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 5)` | read/write | The gap between cells, across and down. Between, not around: `UIPadding` puts space around the outside. |
| `CellSize` | `UDim2` | `UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100)` | read/write | The size of every cell. Scale is a fraction of the parent, so `UDim2.fromScale(0.25, 0.25)` is four across at any window size. |
| `FillDirection` | `Enum.FillDirection` | `Enum.FillDirection.Horizontal` | read/write | Which way a line runs: `Horizontal` fills rows, `Vertical` fills columns. |
| `FillDirectionMaxCells` | `number` | `0` | read/write | The most cells in one line; zero means as many as fit. A line never holds more than fit, whatever this says. |
| `HorizontalAlignment` | `Enum.HorizontalAlignment` | `Enum.HorizontalAlignment.Left` | read/write | Where the whole grid sits across the parent. |
| `SortOrder` | `Enum.SortOrder` | `Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder` | read/write | What order the children go in. |
| `StartCorner` | `Enum.StartCorner` | `Enum.StartCorner.TopLeft` | read/write | The corner the first cell goes in, and so which way the lines run. |
| `VerticalAlignment` | `Enum.VerticalAlignment` | `Enum.VerticalAlignment.Top` | read/write | Where it sits down the parent. |
